description.message: Saves the current page or a link to Later on your own Cognoscimus server. The page is sent as you see it, so pages behind a login keep their text.

serverHint.message: The address of your Cognoscimus server, for example https://books.example.com. Saving asks for access to this server: the extension uses it to hand over the page you are saving.

invalidServer.message: Enter an address that starts with https:// (or http://localhost).

savedLinkOnly.message: Saved. Without access to the server only the link is sent and the server fetches the page itself.
